fusions.name: Stripping Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses a cloud of points in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Gnawed Puncture
fusions.desc: Bores into an afflicted target, dealing 8 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt. Usable only on a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Grain-Stripping Swarm
fusions.desc: Releases a swarm that stays for 10 seconds and stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second. It draws the attention of the enemy you last struck.

fusions.name: Picked to the Bone
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
